method.file_scope: All tracked and nonignored untracked Markdown/HTML files, plus explicit classification of changed/new source documents. Report artifacts count in repository inventory but JSON/CSV/screenshots are not interpreted as HTML links.
method.resolution: Markdown inline destinations and reference definitions, HTML href/src/srcset/poster/data-src; query stripped, URL decoded, public-root HTML paths and directory index.html supported. Own GitHub main/raw and production Hosting links map to local repository/public files only; no remote existence or deployment claim.
method.fragments: HTML id/name and approximated GitHub Markdown heading slugs checked; fenced code ignored. Source text is not otherwise executed.
method.baseline: Target strings present in HEAD source classified carried-forward; new targets are introduced. Missing pilot image curation is reported separately, never silently counted as current-byte native screenshots.
method.limitations: No external URL/network, JS-generated URLs, CSS URL crawl or Markdown reference-use validity check; no prose/claim/legal review.
